statement: NVIDIA and Corning announced a long-term partnership to expand US optical connectivity manufacturing, citing a 10x increase in US-based optical connectivity capacity, a 50-percent-plus expansion in US fiber production capacity, three new plants in North Carolina and Texas and more than 3,000 new jobs.
why: Optical fiber and connectivity are long-lead inputs to AI cluster networking, so a large committed capacity expansion reduces a chokepoint that sits between GPU supply and working AI factories.

impact.mechanism: More domestic optical connectivity and fiber capacity increases the supply of interconnect needed to wire large GPU clusters, easing a non-chip constraint on deployment.

evidence.excerpt: a 10x increase in U.S.-based optical connectivity manufacturing capacity; 50%+ expansion in U.S. fiber production capacity; 3,000+ new high-paying American jobs; three new advanced manufacturing facilities in North Carolina and Texas

confidence.basis: Primary source: official NVIDIA newsroom release with named figures and executive quotes.

dispersion: Figures are stated as multiples and floors against an undisclosed base, so no absolute capacity value is recorded. The release is dated 2026-05-06, older than this cycle recency window.
